name: Solenne Atelier Bias-Cut Blouse
description:
A fluid, long-sleeved blouse cut on the bias in a silk-protein weave that moves like water and catches light along every seam. The collar is a loose, draped cowl that can be worn forward or folded back, and the sleeves taper to a soft cuff that buttons with a single mother-of-nacre synthetic. The color is 'pale mercury' — a shifting silver-white that reads differently depending on the light source, cool in natural light, almost warm under incandescent. The drape is architectural: it falls perfectly, which is the result of the bias cut combined with the weight of the fabric.

Solenne Atelier is a small Tier 5 house operating out of the upper Spire district, designing for clients who have already stopped looking at price tags. The blouse is made to measure, delivered in tissue and a cedar-lined box, and comes with a card noting the name of the person who sewed it. It is, in every technical sense, just a blouse. But it is the best blouse.
what_it_says: You are at the top. You dress without effort because the effort was done for you, invisibly, by someone whose name you actually know.
worn_by: people attending events where clothing is assessed at a glance and judged correctly
story_hooks: The artisan whose name is on the card inside a particular blouse has gone missing — and the last client who received one with her name is being asked questions.
Solenne Atelier keeps meticulous records of every client — a ledger that would be extraordinarily valuable to anyone wanting to map Spire social networks.
A Tier 2 woman finds a Solenne blouse in a donation bin, unworn, tags still on. The cedar box is missing. She wears it to a job interview and something changes.

physical_description.visual_profile: A liquid-elegant silhouette that seems to flow rather than hang. The cowl collar creates a soft, romantic neckline that can be worn draped forward or folded back for a sharper line. Long tapered sleeves end in delicate cuffs. The bias cut creates diagonal seams that catch light and movement, giving the garment an almost iridescent quality despite its simplicity.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed yet precision-tailored. The bias cut ensures perfect drape without clinging. Sleeves taper gradually to the wrist. The body skims without compression, allowing for layering underneath. Made to measure for the wearer's exact proportions.
physical_description.primary_material: Silk-protein weave — a lab-cultured hybrid that mimics natural silk's luminosity while offering superior durability and temperature regulation. Appears organic but engineered to perfection.
physical_description.texture: Fluid and smooth with a subtle sheen. The surface catches light along every seam created by the bias cut, creating shifting highlights that move with the wearer. Feels weightless but substantial.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pale mercury — a shifting silver-white that transforms with ambient light. Cool and ethereal under natural or blue-spectrum light, warmer and almost champagne-toned under incandescent. No patterns; the visual interest comes entirely from the interplay of fabric weight, bias seams, and light.
physical_description.closures: Single mother-of-nacre synthetic button at each cuff. Minimal fastening; the cowl collar requires no closure.
distinctive_features: Architectural bias-cut construction creating diagonal seams that serve as light-catching design elements
Draped cowl collar offering versatile styling options
Made-to-measure tailoring with personalized maker's card
Perfectly weighted fabric that maintains drape with minimal intervention
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury, despite Tier 5 origin — this is artisanal wealth, not corporate wealth. The price point is aspirational even for Tier 2 corpo workers.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by clients who have transcended visible status signaling. The wearer likely works in creative, diplomatic, or private sectors where individual taste matters more than corporate affiliation. Signals discernment, access, and comfort with understated luxury. The maker's card implies a personal relationship with a bespoke atelier.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, with the potential to age beautifully. The bias cut and silk-protein weave resist wrinkles naturally. Over time, it develops a subtle patina rather than visible wear — the fabric softens further, the sheen deepens, the light-catching qualities intensify slightly.
